_about: The Ultimate Fighter season inventory. Every record carries its source and a confidence level, and nothing is asserted that a source did not state. 'status' describes OUR coverage, not the season's: complete means we hold season metadata AND a linked finale AND a bracket; partial means metadata only; ongoing means the season has no winner yet and must never be shown with one.

_provenance.note: Finale event names and dates are reconciled against our own ufc_events table where we hold the card. Where the encyclopedia and our database disagree, the database wins for the event and the disagreement is recorded in conflicts[].
_provenance.finale_resolution: A finale is linked only when the exact final matchup — finalist versus finalist — is found in our own ufc_bouts with a result. An earlier pass matched on a champion appearing somewhere on a card and produced two false positives, both recorded in the seasons they affected. Finals contested on different cards are supported: final_bouts is a list and each entry carries its own event and date.

_conflicts.detail: A summary read of the franchise page reported Joseph Morales and Daniil Donchenko as the season 33 winners. The season's own page lists them only as FINALISTS (flyweight: Morales vs Alibi Idiris; welterweight: Donchenko vs Matt Dixon) and does not state the finale results. Recorded as finalists with winner unknown rather than resolving the disagreement in either direction.
The franchise page's own summary says the most recent completed season is 32, while listing season 33 with results. Unresolved; season 33 is carried as completion_unverified.

buckets.bracket_full: every documented round loaded, no unresolved dispute
buckets.bracket_partial: some rounds loaded, or a dispute is still open
buckets.metadata_only: season facts only; no tournament bouts loaded

_coverage_model.rule: The three buckets are mutually exclusive and every season is in exactly one, so they sum to the season count.
_coverage_model.finale_note: finale_linked is tracked separately and is NOT coverage. Holding a finale card means we hold a UFC event; it says nothing about whether the tournament that led to it is in the archive.
_coverage_model.state_note: season_state (completed | ongoing) is a fact about the season, not about us.
